# Hytronics Corp. — Full summary for AI agents

Source site: https://www.hytronicscorp.com/
Short index: https://www.hytronicscorp.com/llms.txt

## Company

Hytronics Corp. designs and manufactures commercial and military chokes, inductors, and transformers. Expertise includes high-frequency switching magnetics and telecommunication applications. Many standard designs are available for high-frequency LAN applications.

- Established: 1967
- Cage Code: 29525
- Quality: ISO 9001:2015 (Florida and Costa Rica certificates available on site)
- Manufacturing centers: United States and Costa Rica
- Parent: Electro Technik Industries, Inc. (ETI)

## Capabilities (from company profile)

- LAN applications; frequency capabilities up to 1 GHz
- 50/60 Hz power capability to 1 KVA
- High voltage devices to 30,000 Vdc/Vac
- Surface mount packages for miniature power inductors and switching power supply magnetics
- Specialty: Scott-T devices, magnetic amplifiers, magnetic shunt current limited transformers, ferro-resonant transformers, custom and standard RF inductors, high voltage devices
